theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners lead with the highest score and strongest durability_bar (0.84, hurst_tag 'trend') plus full breadth (1.0), which together suggest robust, self-sustaining leadership rather than a narrow spike; the validated absolute-trend gate supports staying in this theme, and crowding (z 1.02, crowded true) is a sizing caution only, not a reason to avoid. Because momentum rank itself is only a focus lens and this theme is crowded, I do not treat leadership as a buy trigger but lean overweight directionally while the trend-gate remains intact.
